description: This line plot illustrates the growth in vocabulary size over the number of iterations for three languages—Spanish, Korean, and Japanese—within the DIY-MKG system. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Iterations,” spans from 0 to 500 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled “Vocabulary Size,” ranges from 0 to 5000 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 1000. The plot displays three lines: the blue line for Spanish starts at 0 and rises to approximately 4,200 at iteration 500; the orange line for Korean starts at 0 and rises to approximately 3,100 at iteration 500; and the green line for Japanese starts at 0 and rises to approximately 3,000 at iteration 500. All three lines begin at the origin (0,0) and increase steadily, with the Spanish line consistently above the other two throughout the iteration range.
